e04.saheli: सांझरे टहलण रो विचार घणो ही बढ़िया है भंवरी जी। म्हैं थांने याद दिराय देसूं।

z07.saheli: Calendar dekh liya hai. Main batati hoon ki agle mahine parivaar kahan jaane ka plan bana raha hai.
z07.text: Calendar ki photo bheji hai, where is the family planning to go next month?

z08.saheli: Badi pyaari photo hai! Main dekh kar batati hoon cat ka kya naam hai.
z08.text: Cat ki photo bheji hai, what is the cat's name?

z09.saheli: Photo mil gayi hai. Main check karke batati hoon ki Sundays ko Maaji ko kaun phone karta hai.
z09.text: Call log ki photo bheji hai, who calls Bhanwari on Sundays?

z10.saheli: Diary ki photo dekh li hai. Main dekh kar batati hoon ki Pankaj ka birthday kab aata hai.
z10.text: Purani diary ki photo dekho, when is Pankaj's birthday?
